answer: Because the sonnet salt is published after the yarrow checkpoint, the mirror audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 150 keys therefore forfeits for 150 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 203 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
